title: CSS
tagline: Cascade mastery, Flexbox & Grid layout systems, responsive architecture, animations, and modern CSS.
description: Master modern CSS from the box model, specificity, and cascade layers through Flexbox, CSS Grid, subgrid, container queries, fluid typography, custom properties, compositor-only animations, and maintainable design systems.
prerequisites: HTML document structure and semantic tags
whatYoullLearn: Predict and control Cascade, Specificity, Inheritance, and @layer ordering
Build responsive layouts using Flexbox, CSS Grid, auto-fit, and Subgrid
Architect scalable Light/Dark themes with CSS Custom Properties and color-mix()
Use Container Queries (@container), :has(), and clamp() fluid typography
Create jank-free 60fps compositor animations honoring prefers-reduced-motion
Debug stacking contexts, z-index isolation, and overflow clipping bugs

levelSummaries.Beginner: Selectors, specificity, box model, units, typography, colors, and normal document flow.
levelSummaries.Intermediate: Flexbox, CSS Grid, positioning, stacking contexts, responsive queries, and transitions.
levelSummaries.Advanced: Cascade @layer, Container Queries, :has(), custom properties, subgrid, and render performance.

projectTitle: Dual-Theme SaaS Pricing & Dashboard System in Pure Modern CSS
